title: Onboard nimbus-30b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Chen
description:
This PR adds onboarding artifacts for nimbus-30b v1.0: model metadata, performance profiles for supported instance types, and automation to append a condensed changelog entry into the models changelog. Motivation: nimbus-30b is a high-throughput 30B model variant that we want available in the model catalog with verified perf characteristics and automated release notes so product and docs teams have a short, machine-friendly changelog entry for each model release.

What this PR does (high level):
- Add model metadata JSON with schema-compliant fields (architectures, tokenizer, license, recommended quantizations).
- Add perf profile YAMLs for 1xA100, 2xA100, and 8xH100 configurations, including latency P50/P95 and tokens/sec numbers from bench runs.
- Add a small automation script and CI workflow that validates perf profile completeness and appends a summary entry to models/CHANGELOG.md on merge.
- Wire the model into the catalog index and add a short README with model caveats and recommended prompts for eval.

Checklist:
- [x] metadata schema validated (unit tests)
- [x] perf profiles produced from benchmark-lab run 2025-01-10
- [x] changelog automation unit tested in CI
- [x] docs README for internal reference added

Notes for reviewers: please focus on the perf numbers (we've included raw bench artifacts as links), the automation idempotency (script is safe if changelog already contains an entry for this model/version), and any missing security/license fields in metadata. Related Linear tasks: ENG-3245, PM-812. Related support ticket SUP-1428 (customer request to onboard nimbus-30b).
